scenes.text: Discuss lawful authority, fairness and how to raise concerns safely
Authority: the recognised right to make decisions within a responsibility. Power: the ability to influence actions or decisions.
Rule of law: the principle that everyone must follow fair laws. Participation: having a voice in decisions that affect the group. Abuse of power: using authority to harm or unfairly control others.
Draw a chart showing one authority figure and a responsibility they should fulfil.
